'''2013 Match Play Championship Day 1 Aaron Nelson LS Plead My Case To The Senate''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Aaron Nelson]] at [[2013 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Plead My Case To The Senate / Senators In Laager]]
* '''Username:''' hrdog2003
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
